verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 2 that year.

notes.text:
Produced and mixed at A-Wave Studio London, Spring 2009
Additional Production at the Bananamoon Observatory NSW Australia
Rhythm tracks recorded at 2khz Studios London, February 2009
Yuji Katsui's electric violin recorded at Float, Tokyo
Mastered at The Exchange London

Released by G-Wave - distributed by SRD
℗ and © A-Wave.com Ltd 2009
Published by Stage Three Music/copyright control

Deluxe 2LP, 180gm vinyl numbered ltd. edition with booklet, poster + CD version in a wallet.

Both vinyls are housed in white paper die cut sleeves

GAS will have 200 copies out of a 1000 numbered limited edition pressing of this de-luxe double 180gm vinyl edition of '2032'. They come in a tri-fold sleeve with an LP sized 12 page booklet and large high quality full colour poster plus a CD version of the album in a simple wallet. As a bonus to celebrate this first 'home-grown' Gong vinyl for many years also included 2 different black and white A5 printed post-cards of Daevid's commission drawings.
